description: Extend the Python dictionary-generator to emit a structured skill-tooltip dataset (data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json) plus a fact-label dictionary (data/dictionaries/pt-br/fact_labels.json). This captures name/type/description/flags/categories and the full facts[] (with the value fields needed to format each tooltip line) so the C++ side can reconstruct a complete translated tooltip from a matched skill NAME. Idempotent/resumable (reuses the existing populated cache). This Python tool does NOT go through the C++/MSVC build and does NOT run in CI.
steps: In tools/dictionary-generator/gw2_api.py, add a function to extract the full structured skill object needed for tooltips. Add `extract_skill_tooltip(obj: dict) -> dict` that returns {id, name, type, description, flags (list[str]), categories (list[str]), facts (list[dict])}. For each fact in obj.get('facts', []) or [], produce a normalized fact dict preserving: 'type' (the fact kind, e.g. Damage/Duration/Recharge/Range/Radius/Buff/PrefixedBuff/Number/Percent/Distance/Time/ComboField/ComboFinisher/AttributeAdjust/StunBreak/Unblockable/NoData/Heal/HealingAdjust and any UNLISTED kind such as 'BuffArray' or empty string, kept verbatim), a cleaned 'text' label (strip HTML-like markup: remove any '<...>' tags e.g. '<c=@abilitytype>Field Damage</c>' -> 'Field Damage'; keep the inner text), and every present value field among: value, duration, distance, percent, hit_count, dmg_multiplier, apply_count, status, description, field_type, finisher_type, target. For PrefixedBuff, also capture a nested 'prefix' dict with its cleaned text/status/description. Do NOT include the 'icon' URLs. Add a small helper `strip_markup(s: str) -> str` (regex remove '<[^>]*>') used for the label and for buff status/description strings.

In tools/dictionary-generator/gw2_api.py, add module constant SKILLDATA_DEFAULT_OUTPUT semantics via generate_dictionaries.py (below); no network changes needed - the existing GW2Client.iter_details already yields full objects. Keep extract_text_fields unchanged (still used by the name+description dictionary path).

In tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py, add a new pipeline function `generate_skill_tooltips(client, trans, skilldata_output_dir, fact_labels_output_dir, limit, no_translate)`. It iterates skills via client.iter_details('skills', ids, lang='en'), builds a per-skill tooltip record with extract_skill_tooltip, and TRANSLATES (via trans.translate, cached) the human-readable strings: name, type, description, each fact's cleaned label ('text'), and for Buff/PrefixedBuff facts the 'status' and 'description' (and nested prefix status/description). Store BOTH the English and translated form for name (name_en + name) and translated forms for type/description/labels/status/description so the C++ side has ready strings. Collect the set of ALL distinct cleaned fact labels encountered into a dict {label_en -> translated} for the fact_labels dictionary.

In generate_dictionaries.py, define a CURATED label map (dict) of common EN fact labels -> PT-BR to guarantee correct terminology, applied BEFORE falling back to Argos: at minimum Damage->Dano, Number of Targets->Número de Alvos, Duration->Duração, Recharge->Recarga, Range->Alcance, Radius->Raio, Combo Field->Campo de Combo, Combo Finisher->Finalizador de Combo, Healing->Cura, Might->Poder, Fury->Fúria, Vulnerability->Vulnerabilidade, Regeneration->Regeneração, Movement Speed->Velocidade de Movimento, Bleeding->Sangramento, Burning->Queimadura, Poison->Veneno, Chilled->Congelamento, Crippled->Aleijamento, Immobile->Imobilizado, Weakness->Fraqueza, Stun->Atordoamento, Daze->Tontura, Protection->Proteção, Aegis->Égide, Quickness->Rapidez, Stability->Estabilidade, Swiftness->Ligeireza, Vigor->Vigor, Resistance->Resistência, Torment->Tormento, Confusion->Confusão, Number of Pulses->Número de Pulsos, Count Recharge->Recarga de Carga, Combo->Combo, Distance->Distância, Pulses->Pulsos, Cast Time->Tempo de Conjuração, Activation->Ativação. Provide a helper translate_label(label_en) that returns the curated value if present (case-insensitive on the cleaned label), else trans.translate(label_en) when not no_translate, else label_en. Use this same helper for fact labels AND status strings where a curated term exists.

In generate_dictionaries.py, write the skill-tooltip dataset to data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json with schema {"locale":"pt-br","category":"skills_tooltips","version":VERSION,"skills":[ {"name_en":..., "name":..., "type":..., "description":..., "flags":[...], "categories":[...], "facts":[ {"type":<kind>, "label_en":..., "label":<translated>, plus present value fields value/duration/distance/percent/hit_count/dmg_multiplier/apply_count/status/status_en/description/field_type/finisher_type/target, and for PrefixedBuff a nested "prefix":{...}} ] } ]}. Skills are keyed for search by normalized name_en (dedup by normalize_key(name_en); first occurrence wins; skip empty names). Add a new writer helper `write_skilldata(output_dir, dataset)` that writes UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False, indent=4, trailing newline (mirroring write_dictionary).

In generate_dictionaries.py, write data/dictionaries/pt-br/fact_labels.json using the EXISTING build_dictionary('fact_labels', pairs) + write_dictionary path so it is byte-compatible with the C++ dictionary loader schema {locale,category:'fact_labels',version,entries:[{en,translated}]}. Populate pairs from the collected distinct-label map. Ensure CATEGORY_FILENAMES gets a 'fact_labels' -> 'fact_labels.json' entry so write_dictionary names the file correctly.

In generate_dictionaries.py, add CLI wiring: a new --category choice 'skill_tooltips' (add to the choices list alongside gw2_api.SUPPORTED_ENDPOINTS) that runs generate_skill_tooltips; a --skilldata-output-dir arg (default Path('data/skilldata/pt-br')); honor --limit, --no-translate, --dry-run. When --category all is chosen, also run skill_tooltips. Keep the existing per-endpoint behavior intact (additive).

Extend run_self_checks() (the --dry-run path) with new offline self-checks that need NO network and NO Argos: (a) strip_markup('<c=@abilitytype>Field Damage</c>') == 'Field Damage'; (b) extract_skill_tooltip on an in-memory sample object with mixed fact types (including one UNLISTED type like 'BuffArray' and a Buff with status/duration/apply_count and a PrefixedBuff with a nested prefix) yields the expected normalized structure with value fields preserved and markup stripped and NO 'icon' keys; (c) the skills_tooltips dataset schema builder produces {locale,category:'skill_tooltips'|'skills_tooltips',version,skills:[...]} with a skill dedup by normalized name; (d) translate_label returns the curated PT-BR for a known label (e.g. 'Damage'->'Dano') case-insensitively and passes through unknown labels in no-translate mode. All new checks must print [OK]/[FALHOU] like the existing ones and contribute to the exit code.

Update tools/dictionary-generator/README.md: document the new skill_tooltips category, the data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json output and its schema, the fact_labels.json output, the curated-label map, and the EXACT commands to (1) run offline self-checks, (2) generate an offline sample without translation, and (3) regenerate the FULL translated dataset. State clearly this tool is NOT part of the C++/MSVC build and does NOT run in CI.

Generate a representative SAMPLE offline to prove the files exist: run `python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --category skill_tooltips --limit 400 --no-translate` (uses the already-populated raw cache; passthrough translations). Confirm data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json and data/dictionaries/pt-br/fact_labels.json are created and well-formed JSON. Record in findings the actual number of skills and distinct fact labels generated, and the exact command to regenerate the FULL translated dataset (`python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --category skill_tooltips`).
acceptance_criteria: `python3 -m py_compile tools/dictionary-generator/gw2_api.py tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py tools/dictionary-generator/translator.py` succeeds with no errors.

`python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --dry-run` exits 0 and prints [OK] for the new self-checks (strip_markup, extract_skill_tooltip with an unlisted fact type, skill_tooltips schema, curated translate_label).

`python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --category skill_tooltips --limit 400 --no-translate` creates data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json (valid JSON, category 'skills_tooltips', a non-empty skills[] each with name_en/name/type/description/facts[]) and data/dictionaries/pt-br/fact_labels.json (valid JSON, category 'fact_labels', schema {en,translated} entries).

skills_tooltips.json facts preserve fact kind + cleaned (markup-free) label + present value fields; Buff/PrefixedBuff facts carry status/duration/apply_count/description and nested prefix where present; no 'icon' URLs are stored.
Unknown/unlisted fact kinds (e.g. 'BuffArray', empty string) are preserved verbatim in 'type' and do not crash the generator.
README updated with the new category, output schemas, and the exact full-regeneration command.
verification: Run `python3 -m py_compile` on the three changed .py files.

Run `python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --category skill_tooltips --limit 400 --no-translate` and then validate both output files parse as JSON and have the required top-level keys and a non-empty skills[]/entries[].
findings: Implemented in tools/dictionary-generator. gw2_api.py: added strip_markup() (regex '<[^>]*>') and extract_skill_tooltip() (normalizes facts, preserves verbatim type incl. 'BuffArray'/empty, keeps value fields value/duration/distance/percent/hit_count/dmg_multiplier/apply_count/status/description/field_type/finisher_type/target, nested prefix for PrefixedBuff, strips markup, NEVER stores 'icon'). generate_dictionaries.py: added CURATED_LABELS (39 EN->PT-BR terms), translate_label() (curated case-insensitive -> Argos -> passthrough), write_skilldata(), build_skill_tooltips_dataset() (dedup by normalized name_en), generate_skill_tooltips(), CLI --category 'skill_tooltips' + --skilldata-output-dir, 'all' now includes skill_tooltips, and 4 new offline self-checks (strip_markup, extract_skill_tooltip mixed types, dataset schema+dedup, translate_label curated/passthrough). fact_labels.json reuses build_dictionary+write_dictionary with new CATEGORY_FILENAMES['fact_labels'] entry (byte-compatible {locale,category,version,entries:[{en,translated}]}). VERIFIED: py_compile of all 3 .py files OK; --dry-run exits 0 with 11/11 [OK] (7 pre-existing + 4 new). SAMPLE (offline, --no-translate, note: 'requests' had to be pip-installed because GW2Client.__init__ eagerly imports requests even for cached runs; 0 HTTP requests actually made): 'python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --category skill_tooltips --limit 400 --no-translate' produced data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json = 335 skills (deduped from 400 objects) and data/dictionaries/pt-br/fact_labels.json = 120 distinct fact labels. Both validated as well-formed JSON with required top-level keys, non-empty skills[]/entries[], no 'icon' keys, PrefixedBuff nested prefix present. Full distinct fact-label count across the whole endpoint is ~774 per context (this 400-id sample surfaced 120). REGENERATE FULL TRANSLATED DATASET (requires Argos en->pt model installed via --install-model): python3 tools/dictionary-generator/generate_dictionaries.py --category skill_tooltips
